text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq to regain its international and Arab position following its acceptance of U.N. terms for partial flow of oil.
- Boutros-Ghali praises Iraq's cooperation with U.N.
- Central bank says it has no plans to change currency.
- Iraqi ports ready to receive tankers, cargo ships.
- Lloyds experts visit Iraq's southern ports.
- Turkish official says Iraqi oil to flow before January 15.
- UAE newspapers call for removal of Rolf Ekeus, chairman of the U.N. Special Commission on Iraq.
- Central bank to issue new bonds next month.
- Southern Oil Company will be ready to export oil early December.
- Trade ministry pumps more foodstuffs to local markets.
- Foreign minister meets Russian parliamentary delegation.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
